requests.documentation:
A cxx extension to the language server protocol.

The request is sent from the client to the server to obtain the code the
compiler generates for a text document. The server responds with `null` when
it was built without a code generator.

structures.name: EmitCodeParams
structures.documentation: The parameters of a cxx/emitCode request.

properties.name: textDocument
properties.documentation: The document to generate the code for.

properties.name: format
properties.documentation: The format of the generated code.

properties.name: debugInfo
properties.documentation: Whether the generated code carries the source locations. Defaults to false.

properties.name: optimizationLevel
properties.documentation: The optimization level the code is generated with, from 0 to 3. Defaults to 0.

properties.name: mlirPipeline
properties.documentation: The MLIR pass pipeline to run before emission. Cxx IR displays its result; the host formats continue through LLVM lowering; the device kernel formats ignore it and run the device pipeline. Defaults to an empty pipeline.

structures.name: EmitCodeResult
structures.documentation: The code generated for a text document.

properties.name: format
properties.documentation: The format the code was generated in.

properties.name: text
properties.documentation: The generated code, base64 encoded for the binary formats. Empty when the document has errors.

properties.name: error
properties.documentation: Why no code was generated for a document without errors, for instance a link error.

properties.name: kernels
properties.documentation: The device kernels of the document, for the kernel formats. Kernels that fail to compile are reported in `error`.

structures.name: EmitCodeKernel
structures.documentation: A device kernel generated for a text document.

properties.name: manifest
properties.documentation: The kernel manifest: the entry point, the workgroup size and the resources bound by name.

properties.name: code
properties.documentation: The kernel code: WGSL source text, or a SPIR-V module base64 encoded.

enumerations.name: EmitCodeFormat
enumerations.documentation: The formats the cxx code generator can emit.

values.name: CxxIR
values.documentation: The cxx dialect of MLIR, before any lowering.

values.name: MLIR
values.documentation: MLIR, after the cxx dialect was lowered; under a device profile, the GPU dialect modules of the kernels, the input of both the WGSL and the SPIR-V backends.

values.name: Assembly
values.documentation: Target assembly; under a device profile, the SPIR-V dialect modules of the kernels.

values.name: Executable
values.documentation: A WebAssembly executable, the object code linked with the libraries of the server, base64 encoded.

values.name: WGSL
values.documentation: The WGSL compute shaders of the kernels of the document.

values.name: SPIRV
values.documentation: The SPIR-V compute modules of the kernels of the document, base64 encoded.
